1. Put your pot on the firepit and gather up your ingredients. Make sure your liquids are in a bowl.

3. Light the fire and have a bowl or crock ready to scoop out the au gratin when cooked.

game:handbook-mealrecipe-notestext-augra: Typically mixed with vegetables or seafood, the creamy cheese sauce hardens into a browned crust that adds a crunchy roasted flavor to the meal. Cooked alone, the cheese sauce is similar to fondue.
game:handbook-mealrecipe-notestext-compo: A warm, sweet dessert made of fruit in cooked in sugar syrup and occasionally wine. Can also be served chilled.
game:handbook-mealrecipe-notestext-meaty:
An uncooked mixture of vegetables and other foods, salads can fit up to 6 different ingredients as opposed to a cooking pot's 4. However, they do not store for long. Eat them quickly!
NOTE: Any meat added to salads must be cured or cooked first. We wouldn't want to get sick!
game:handbook-mealrecipe-notestext-pasta: Also known as 'pasta salad', a number of ingredients are combined with pre-cooked pasta to produce a fresh and flavorful meal. Cold pasta meals can fit up to 6 different ingredients as opposed to a cooking pot's 4.

Of the 1,000 forms of pasta, this is but one of them.
Of the 1,000,000 variants of pasta meals, all are united in love.
Of the 1,000,000,000 mouths to be fed, a chorus emerges.

NOTE: Hot pasta lasts longer than cold pasta, due to all of the ingredients being cooked together.
game:handbook-mealrecipe-notestext-ricea: Primarily made with rice and cooked in a stock or broth with other ingredients, this dish has as many names as it does grains of rice.
game:handbook-mealrecipe-notestext-yogur: A healthy snack in its own right, enhanced by the addition of more fresh fruit and nuts and topped with syrup or gelatin. Yogurt meals can fit up to 6 different ingredients as opposed to a cooking pot's 4.
expandedfoodsguide3-text:
Cooking 103 - Expanded Meals
The culinary arts, explained.

Documentation on this mod can be found here.
Updated versions can be found here.

Introduction
If you want to make the most out of your culinary experience, then learn how to make the following meals. Recipes are found in each meal's handbook entry.

NEW MEALS

Au Gratin (Cooking Meal)
Compôte (Cooking Meal)
Cold Pasta (Mixing Meal)
Hot Pasta (Cooking Meal)
Pilaf (Cooking Meal)
Salad (Mixing Meal)
Yogurt Meal (Mixing Meal)

Additions to Meat Stew
Meat stews also accept dumplings, bread crumbs, boiled/pickled eggs, cooked pasta, and dehydrated/dried berries. You can also add 0.1 L of fish sauce, soy sauce, food oil, wine, or lard before you start cooking, as a topping. You can also add 0.5 L of broth due to this meal being a stew. In addition, you can add 0.1 L of liquid egg yolk for texture.

Additions to Porridge
Porridge also accepts dehydrated/dried berries, peanuts/acorns, and meat/fish/sausage. You can also add 0.1 L of milk, maple syrup, birch syrup, fruit syrup, lard, or broth before cooking, as a topping.

Additions to Soup
Soup now accepts vegetable juice or broth instead of water. You may also add dumplings, meat/fish/sausage, bread crumbs, amaranth/flax/rice/spelt/sunflower grain, boiled/pickled eggs, and noodles. In addition, you can add 0.1 L of liquid egg yolk for texture.

Additions to Veggie Stew
Veggie stews also accept dumplings, bread crumbs, and cooked pasta. You can also add 0.1 L of fish sauce, soy sauce, food oil, lard, or alcohol before cooking, as a topping. You can also add 0.5 L of broth due to this meal being a stew. In addition, you can add 0.1 L of liquid egg yolk for texture.

Additions to Scrambled Eggs
Instead of using eggs, scrambled eggs now require 0.2 L of liquid egg in one slot. It accepts all kinds of milk; all vegetables, meat nuggets, sausage, and boiled/pickled eggs. You can also add 0.1 L of fish sauce, soy sauce, food oil, and lard before cooking, as a topping.
